# RichText

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A rich text element that supports mixed styling within a single flowing paragraph. Text spans with different fonts, sizes, colors, weights, and decorations flow together with automatic word wrapping across span boundaries.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new RichText()
```

## Properties

- [`Alignment`](#alignment): Paragraph alignment.
- [`DefaultStyle`](#defaultstyle): Default style inherited by all spans.
- [`MinLinesAfterBreak`](#minlinesafterbreak): Minimum number of lines that must appear after a page break (widow control).
- [`MinLinesBeforeBreak`](#minlinesbeforebreak): Minimum number of lines to render before a page break (orphan control).
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): RichText renders one flowing paragraph, so it tags as /P.

### `Alignment`

```csharp
TextAlignment Alignment { get; set; }
```

Paragraph alignment. When not set explicitly, an enclosing `Container` whose `HorizontalAlignment` is Start/Center/End supplies an ambient default instead of the plain Left below; see `EffectiveAlignment`.

### `DefaultStyle`

```csharp
TextStyle DefaultStyle { get; set; }
```

Default style inherited by all spans. Span-level styles override these values.

### `MinLinesAfterBreak`

```csharp
int MinLinesAfterBreak { get; set; }
```

Minimum number of lines that must appear after a page break (widow control).

### `MinLinesBeforeBreak`

```csharp
int MinLinesBeforeBreak { get; set; }
```

Minimum number of lines to render before a page break (orphan control).

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

RichText renders one flowing paragraph, so it tags as /P. Without a role the pipeline would emit its text as untagged content (PDF/UA 7.1).

## Methods

- [`Line`](#line): Adds a text span followed by a line break.
- [`LineBreak`](#linebreak): Adds a line break (empty line).
- [`Link`](#link): Adds a span that links to a URI, in the flow of the paragraph.
- [`RenderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders as many lines as fit on the current page and reports whether the text is complete or needs another page.
- [`ResetState`](#resetstate): Clears the continuation state so the text can be rendered again from the start.
- [`Span`](#span): Adds a text span with an explicit style.

### `Line`

```csharp
RichText Line(string text, TextStyle style = null)
```

Adds a text span followed by a line break.

### `LineBreak`

```csharp
RichText LineBreak()
```

Adds a line break (empty line).

### `Link`

```csharp
RichText Link(string text, string uri, TextStyle style = null)
RichText Link(string text, string uri, Action<TextStyle> configure)
```

Adds a span that links to a URI, in the flow of the paragraph.

Example:

```csharp
new RichText() .Span("Read our ") .Link("terms of service", "https://example.com/terms", s => s.WithColor(ColorPalette.Blue[700]).Underline()) .Span(" before you order.");
```

### `RenderStateful`

```csharp
RenderStatus RenderStateful(RenderContext ctx, float width)
```

Renders as many lines as fit on the current page and reports whether the text is complete or needs another page.

### `ResetState`

```csharp
void ResetState()
```

Clears the continuation state so the text can be rendered again from the start.

### `Span`

```csharp
RichText Span(string text, TextStyle style = null)
RichText Span(string text, Action<TextStyle> configure)
```

Adds a text span with an explicit style.

Example:

```csharp
var rich = new RichText(); rich.Span("Payment due within "); rich.Span("30 days", s => s.Bold()); rich.Span(" of the invoice date, or ", s => s.Underline());
```
